_doc: Machine-readable arch FACTS - mirror of planning-constants.md. Reference facts: read directly, or by a rule engine where one is shipped. Keyed by arch (SKU peaks/ridge live in sku.json). Every value is calibratable; recalibrate from trace per roofline-models.md ## Calibration.

gfx942._sched_interval_note: buffer_load_issue_cyc = the global-load (GR) throughput interval the interleave scheduler spreads MFMA against; the MFMA-per-load ratio = buffer_load_issue_cyc / mfma_cadence_cyc[dtype]. lds_sp_fifo_entries_per_simd_pair x (2 pairs/CU) = ds_reads in flight/CU before the steady ds_read_b*_conflict_free_cyc rate applies (burst model).
gfx942._vgpr_occupancy_basis: compiler-derived (LLVM `; Occupancy:` sweep, ROCm 7.2.1/LLVM 22; reproduce per scripts/amd_occupancy.py docstring). Steps are [max_next_free_vgpr, waves_per_simd] -- the LAST VGPR count that still fits that many waves. waves = min(cap, file // (granule * ceil(vgpr/granule))). next_free_vgpr is the ArchVGPR+AGPR COMBINED budget on CDNA.
gfx942._cvt_off_f32_i4_note: Records ROCDL/MLIR BINDING availability (hasattr(rocdl,'cvt_off_f32_i4')), NOT silicon. The instruction IS in the gfx942 ISA -- v_cvt_off_f32_i4_e32 assembles on gfx942/gfx950/gfx1100/gfx1201 alike -- so false here is a wrapper gap reachable via inline asm, never a hardware does-not-lower ceiling.
gfx942._mfma_valu_coexec_note: MFMA co-issues with VALU (MI-calc: v_mfma_f32_16x16x16_f16 = 16 cyc / 12 co-issuable; 32x32x8 = 32 / 28). RDNA WMMA canNOT co-execute at all -- hiding softmax/dequant VALU under the matrix op is a CDNA-only lever.

gfx950._sched_interval_note: buffer_load_issue_cyc = the global-load (GR) throughput interval the interleave scheduler spreads MFMA against; the MFMA-per-load ratio = buffer_load_issue_cyc / mfma_cadence_cyc[dtype]. lds_sp_fifo_entries_per_simd_pair x (2 pairs/CU) = ds_reads in flight/CU before the steady ds_read_b*_conflict_free_cyc rate applies (burst model).
gfx950._vgpr_occupancy_basis: compiler-derived (LLVM `; Occupancy:` sweep, ROCm 7.2.1/LLVM 22; reproduce per scripts/amd_occupancy.py docstring). Steps are [max_next_free_vgpr, waves_per_simd] -- the LAST VGPR count that still fits that many waves. waves = min(cap, file // (granule * ceil(vgpr/granule))). next_free_vgpr is the ArchVGPR+AGPR COMBINED budget on CDNA.
gfx950._l2_fabric_latency_note: A-NUMBER, gfx950/CDNA4-calibrated (round_44/49 read-latency 256-317 cyc). memory sub=latency fires above this. gfx942/gfx1250 have no calibrated value yet -> classify falls back to thresholds.json (recalibrate per arch; Infinity-Fabric topology/XCD count differ).
gfx950._gws_note: GWS (DS_GWS) is NOT removed on CDNA4 -- ds_gws_init/ds_gws_sema_v assemble on both gfx942 and gfx950; it is removed on RDNA4 (gfx1201 rejects them).

gfx1250._vgpr_occupancy_basis: compiler-derived (LLVM `; Occupancy:` sweep, ROCm 7.2.1/LLVM 22; reproduce per scripts/amd_occupancy.py docstring). gfx1250 is its OWN geometry -- neither the CDNA 512/8 nor the RDNA 1536/24 file applies.
gfx1250._note: MI450; wave32 in-kernel (get_warp_size may return 64 - hardcode 32); microarch constants TBD-probe on target

gfx1201._vgpr_occupancy_basis: compiler-derived (LLVM `; Occupancy:` sweep, ROCm 7.2.1/LLVM 22; reproduce per scripts/amd_occupancy.py docstring). vgpr_per_wave (256) is the per-WAVE addressable cap, NOT the per-SIMD file -- dividing 256 by a kernel's VGPR count (the old calc_perf/hw_budget bug) under-reports RDNA occupancy 2-3x. Same steps measured on gfx1100/gfx1151/gfx1200/gfx1201.
gfx1201._dynamic_vgpr_note: S_ALLOC_VGPR is rejected as 'invalid instruction' by ROCm 7.1 / LLVM 20 for gfx1200 AND gfx1201, and no +dynamic-vgpr subtarget feature exists -- dynamic VGPR is a gfx1250 (CDNA5) feature. Plan RDNA4 occupancy on the static <=256 VGPR/wave model only.
gfx1201._mfma_valu_coexec_note: RDNA WMMA canNOT co-issue with VALU (MI-calc 'Can co-execute with VALU: False' on rdna3 AND rdna4). Do not port a CDNA 'interleave VALU into the MFMA shadow' plan here.
gfx1201._note: R9700/RX9070XT; occupancy-first, no mfma_scaled/blockscale, no TDM; do not apply CDNA combined-512-VGPR formula (rdna-fork.md)

gfx1200._vgpr_occupancy_basis: compiler-derived (same sweep as gfx1201, measured on gfx1200 itself -- not extrapolated).
gfx1200._note: RX9070XT/RX9070. Same RDNA4 microarch as gfx1201; only the occupancy geometry is recorded here, the rest of the RDNA4 facts live under gfx1201.

gfx1151._vgpr_occupancy_basis: compiler-derived (same sweep, measured on gfx1151 itself).
gfx1151._note: Strix Halo APU (AI MAX 395/495); WMMA _w32, LPDDR-attached -- treat the memory roofline as APU-shared, not discrete-GPU HBM

gfx1100._vgpr_occupancy_basis: compiler-derived (same sweep, measured on gfx1100 itself).
